title: Crate Theory Boom Bap Kit Vol. 1
description: 24 hand-selected drum samples chopped from vinyl — kicks, snares, hats, and percs with that dusty, compressed sound. 44.1kHz / 24-bit WAV.

title: Neo Soul Chord Progressions MIDI Pack
description: 40 MIDI chord progressions in the style of D'Angelo, Erykah Badu, and Musiq Soulchild. Extended voicings, jazzy substitutions, minor 7ths — drop them into any DAW.
fileInfo: 40 MIDI files / compatible with all DAWs

title: SP-404 Style Texture Pack
description: Vinyl crackle, tape hiss, room noise, and lo-fi atmosphere samples designed for layering under beats. Inspired by classic MPC and SP-404 production techniques.

title: Lo-Fi Drum Loops Vol. 1
description: 20 original lo-fi drum loops at various BPMs (70–95). Processed through tape emulation and vinyl saturation. Royalty-free, use in any commercial project.

title: Analog Warmth — Serum Preset Pack
description: 50 Serum presets covering warm pads, analog-style bass, Rhodes-inspired keys, and neo soul lead sounds. Built for modern R&B and lo-fi hip hop production.

title: Crate Theory Boom Bap Kit Vol. 2
description: 36 more samples — this time focusing on breaks, chops, and one-shots with heavier compression and mid-range punch. Perfect for East Coast and underground hip hop.
